> 11 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides under 3D Secure. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## 3D Secure

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/3d-secure/overview): Building a modern checkout experience requires that merchants balance security and ease of use for their customers.
- [Onboarding](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/3d-secure/onboarding/): If you do not have a merchant set up yet, read more about [creating an account](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/start/go-live/ruby) first.
- [Step by Step Integration](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/3d-secure/step-by-step-integration/): Before you can initialize the JavaScript SDK, you will need to [generate a client token](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/start/hello-server#generate-a-client-token).
- [Applying 3DS to Transactions and Verifications](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/3d-secure/applying-3ds-to-transactions-and-verifications/): To create a 3D Secure transaction, make a server-side sale call using the payment method single-use-token you received from your client when you verified the credit card on the…
- [Merchant Initiated Authentication (3RI)](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/3d-secure/3ri/): 3DS Requestor Initiated (3RI) or Merchant-initiated authentications allow merchants to generate the necessary authentication data for authorization without the customer being…
- [Rules Manager](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/3d-secure/rules-manager/): To further enhance 3DS2, Braintree now offers merchants 3D Secure Rules Manager, a built-in offering that enables deep customization of when and how to invoke 3DS.
- [Advanced Options](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/3d-secure/advanced-options/): We expose additional information about the authentication request that you can use for more advanced UI flows or risk assessment.
- [Authentication Insight](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/3d-secure/authentication-insight/): Authentication Insight provides you with more details about the regulatory environment and applicable customer authentication regulation for a potential transaction.
- [Testing](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/3d-secure/testing/): The Braintree sandbox allows end-to-end testing for each of the [card brands supported in our 3DS…
- [Applying 3DS to Transactions and Verifications](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/3d-secure/applying-3ds-to-transactions-and-verifications/ruby): To create a 3D Secure transaction, make a server-side sale call using the payment method single-use-token you received from your client when you verified the credit card on the…
- [Authentication Insight](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/3d-secure/authentication-insight/javascript/v3): Authentication Insight provides you with more details about the regulatory environment and applicable customer authentication regulation for a potential transaction.
